## The permanence layer for sovereign AI.

Pirate Face is decentralized infrastructure for sovereign AI. Models are mirrored from Hugging Face as a torrent and held peer-to-peer instead of by a single company.

Read why Pirate Face exists →

A listed magnet gives a model another download path beyond Hugging Face. If the source disappears, peers who still have the files can continue seeding them.

huggingface.co/model removed

pirateface.co/model 1,240 seeding

Where Hugging Face provides a SHA-256, you can compare it with your downloaded file to verify that the bytes match the source.

model-00001.safetensors 6.7 GB

SHA-256 9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08

✓ Matches Hugging Face - bit-for-bit, untampered

Install the pirateface package and your existing transformers or huggingface_hub code downloads models from Pirate Face seeders, with no code changes. Every file is checked against Hugging Face's own fingerprint, and anything the swarm can't supply comes from Hugging Face as usual.

# same script - one package

pip install pirateface

✓ pulling zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash from the swarm

You can browse, download and seed without an account.

Most seeded creator on Pirate Face right now. Live seeder counts.

VIS Qwen3.8-27B 🌱 30 LLM Qwen3-0.6B 🌱 10 LLM Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-GPTQ-Int4 🌱 6

Pirate Face helps keep sovereign AI models available. It indexes eligible Hugging Face models, records source checksums, and lists community torrents so people can share the files.

Do I need an account to use Pirate Face?

No. You can browse, download, and seed without an account.

Why create a Pirate Face account?

An account gives you a place to manage your claimed handles and track your contributions. Claiming reserves a public handle. If you already have a matching Hugging Face account, you can verify your handle to add the creator badge and help prevent impersonation.

Benefits are planned for account holders, including exclusive model releases. Details will be announced on X .

Why use Hugging Face verification if the goal is independence from centralized hosting?

Hugging Face verification shows that a creator controls the matching account or organization. It helps distinguish verified creators from people who have only reserved a handle.

Pirate Face still uses Hugging Face for source records. Listed torrents can keep working while peers have the files. Direct model publishing without Hugging Face is planned, not live.

Does my Pirate Face handle have to match my Hugging Face username?

No. You can reserve an available name, but the verified badge requires verification through the matching Hugging Face account.

For example, a Hugging Face account named john123 can verify john123 , not john .

You can still reserve john , but it stays unverified. The matching Hugging Face owner could reclaim that handle without deleting your Pirate Face account.

Manage your connected accounts and reserved handles in Account .

Could someone impersonate a creator here?

Anyone can reserve a handle, but it stays unverified. The badge requires the matching Hugging Face account or organization, and that owner can reclaim an unverified reservation.

For model files, compare your download's hash with the Hugging Face hash shown on the model page.

What does “checksum-verified” mean?

Pirate Face records a SHA-256 hash for each weight file when Hugging Face provides one. Compare your downloaded file's hash with the value on the model page. A match means the bytes are identical to the recorded Hugging Face file.

How do downloads work, and what if Hugging Face removes a model?

Download from Hugging Face directly, or use the magnet link on a model page when a community torrent is listed.

If the Hugging Face source disappears, the magnet can still work while peers have complete copies. Models recovered through peers are marked Rescued .

Can I search and download from a terminal?

Yes. curl https://pirateface.co/s/qwen prints every matching model that has a torrent, one per line: name, size, seeds, and the magnet last. Join words with + , as in https://pirateface.co/s/kimi+k3 .

To grab the top result with aria2: curl -s https://pirateface.co/s/qwen | head -1 | awk 'print NF' | xargs aria2c --seed-ratio=1.0

Yes. You can submit a torrent for your model directly through Pirate Face, including a surviving copy whose Hugging Face page is gone. Seed the complete files, then provide the magnet, original repository and pinned revision, file hashes, and license evidence.

Today, the form still asks for an original Hugging Face repository and revision. Publishing a model that was never on Hugging Face is planned.

Eligible MIT, Apache-2.0, WTFPL, OpenMDW-1.1, Gemma, LFM and Muse submissions with matching Hugging Face hashes can list immediately; removed sources or uncertain evidence go to review. Gemma, LFM and Muse magnets appear only after the downloader accepts their terms. Kimi-K3 and Audn's Penclaw GLM-5.3 have model-specific exceptions.

A web-seed is an ordinary download URL a torrent client can use alongside peers. Some listed torrents include one for a Hugging Face file.

Coming soon: Pirate Face aims to work as an alternate endpoint for compatible Hugging Face downloads. The goal is to keep existing model paths and change only HF_ENDPOINT .

Points track contributions on the leaderboard . An account's first qualifying handle earns welcome points. Referring a new account's first handle earns 50 points, up to 10 referrals. An approved torrent earns 25 points per distinct model when credited to a verified handle. The first person to ask for a model that then gets rescued earns 5 points if their account has a verified handle: by clicking Rescue on its model page, or by tagging @thepirateface on X from a linked X account. Seeding points are planned, not active.
